task_type: root-cause repair and cross-template runtime QA
requested_outcome: Repair the confirmed slider loading and stale-state failures, then inspect every public page template family for console, network, blank-screen and contradictory loading failures without regressing existing behavior.
natural_destination: VII public routes and their exact local release candidate equivalents on desktop and 390px mobile
authorization_boundary: Local source repair and verification are authorized. Publication, deployment and DNS changes are not authorized by the current request.

lesson_bundle.reason: A local fix is insufficient without affected-family regression evidence.
lesson_bundle.acceptance_impact: Require exact failure reproduction, shared-family checks and natural-destination evidence.

lesson_bundle.reason: The sliders are asynchronous state machines with loading, success, failure and retry states.
lesson_bundle.acceptance_impact: Test transition boundaries, stale data, aborts, retry and reload.

lesson_bundle.reason: Every delayed click must acknowledge the action and remain understandable.
lesson_bundle.acceptance_impact: Verify immediate localized loading feedback and accessible busy state.

lesson_bundle.reason: Every tab, arrow, retry action and filter must work visibly.
lesson_bundle.acceptance_impact: Inventory and exercise shared slider controls and representative route controls.

lesson_bundle.reason: A shared slider defect expands to all worlds and equivalent rails.
lesson_bundle.acceptance_impact: Verify vacation, holiday, spa and event rails on desktop and mobile.

lesson_bundle.reason: The repair must not redesign or remove existing capabilities.
lesson_bundle.acceptance_impact: Record invariants and compare unrelated content, links, cards and layout before and after.

lesson_bundle.reason: The reported failures are especially costly on mobile.
lesson_bundle.acceptance_impact: Run 390x844 interaction and visual checks, including arrows and tab replacement.

lesson_bundle.reason: Any later release requires exact source and rollback evidence.
lesson_bundle.acceptance_impact: Keep production unchanged and prepare version-specific release evidence only after local qualification.

predicted_rejections.rejection: One slider is repaired while another still shows stale cards or a contradictory error.
predicted_rejections.prevention: Repair the shared state boundary and execute the full rail family matrix.
predicted_rejections.acceptance_check: Every selected tab owns matching dates, cards, link and status; no error appears beside usable unlabelled results.

predicted_rejections.rejection: The page looks fixed locally but console or network errors remain on another template.
predicted_rejections.prevention: Build a route-template inventory and scan settled desktop/mobile pages plus key interactions.
predicted_rejections.acceptance_check: Every inventoried template has recorded HTTP, console, network, blank-screen and overflow results.

predicted_rejections.rejection: A performance optimization removes freshness or shows incorrect cached availability.
predicted_rejections.prevention: Separate editorial shell caching from date-specific availability and retain explicit freshness ownership.
predicted_rejections.acceptance_check: Changed-date tabs return matching dated data after reload and never reuse another tab's cards as current truth.

predicted_rejections.rejection: A broad edit breaks existing filters, links, galleries or mobile layout.
predicted_rejections.prevention: Keep the change at the shared causal boundary and run targeted-change invariants on representative routes.
predicted_rejections.acceptance_check: Search filter, business gallery, navigation, 404, language control and responsive geometry remain passing.

predicted_rejections.rejection: A passing unit suite is presented as proof of the public product.
predicted_rejections.prevention: Distinguish local qualification from production verification and do not deploy without explicit authorization.
predicted_rejections.acceptance_check: Final status names exact local commit and leaves production unchanged unless separately authorized.

affected_family: shared discovery request, cache and stale-result helpers
public API routes feeding those rails
homepage, world index, search, semantic landing, detail, account, favorites, guides, legal, admin sign-in and not-found templates
desktop and 390px mobile loading, success, empty, failure, retry, reload and navigation states

midpoint_gate.trigger: The first failing slider passes the exact stale/error transition locally with a source-level regression test.
checks: exact tab owns matching dated results
no simultaneous usable results and terminal error

attack_questions: Can a rapid tab switch let an older response replace the current selection?
Can a timed-out refresh show an error beside usable results without a last-verified disclosure?
Can any inventoried route produce a console error, failed critical request, blank first viewport or stuck busy state?
Can mobile arrows, reload or breakpoint changes lose the selected tab or lock scrolling?
Did the repair alter unrelated search, gallery, navigation, content or availability truth?
adversarial_close.natural_destination_evidence: Screenshots and runtime ledgers from exact local candidate routes, followed by production evidence only after separate publication authorization.
adversarial_close.affected_family_evidence: Automated affected-family tests plus desktop/mobile browser matrix covering every rail and every public template class.

effectiveness.baseline: Production v914 showed a spa rail failing after about 20 seconds, an event rail settling after about 8.5 seconds, and a holiday tab displaying stale dates with a terminal error.
effectiveness.target: All rail-family state tests pass on the first candidate and every template has explicit runtime evidence with zero unresolved high or critical defects.
